summary.text: Scott Webster is a Republican Iowa state senator who has represented District 47 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he previously served as an alderman in Bettendorf and as president of Home Builders of Iowa.

paragraphs.text: Scott Webster graduated from Bettendorf High School in 1998.
His career experience includes owning Webster Properties LLC and Premier Custom Homes LLC, and he served as president of Home Builders of Iowa and as an alderman with the City of Bettendorf.
He assumed office in the Iowa State Senate on January 3, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
